meta.title: OpenCode
meta.description: An agent preset that delegates every task to the OpenCode CLI: it holds no file or shell tools of its own, so the only way to inspect or change the workspace is the `subagent_opencode` tool. It binds the provider name `opencode-preset`, which a profile supplies with `@sredevopsorg/dsh-subagent-opencode`, so it never collides with that bundle's own `opencode` provider. A Web settings page edits the continuation watcher from the Plugins page.
